calibration.ece: sum_bins(abs(sum(confidence_ppm) - 1000000 * sum(success_label))) / total_rows; fixed bins min(9, confidence_ppm*10//1000001); store ceiling in native ppm
calibration.failure: preserve raw metrics and artifacts; construct native profile with measured values unchanged so real bootstrap rejects if any frozen gate fails; never tune scale, model, action or threshold after observing results
calibration.interpretation: latent persistence confidence is an unqualified hypothesis; semantic success and confidence are not equivalent
calibration.intervals: report descriptive Wilson 95% OOD-FAR interval, not a gate or guarantee
calibration.native_measured_values: max(calibration_cohort_metric, verification_cohort_metric); bind both complete raw cohorts in artifacts
calibration.ood_false_acceptance: count(predeclared_ood AND ood_ppm <= maximum_ood_ppm) / count(predeclared_ood); store ceiling in native ppm
calibration.undefined_denominator: report null, never zero; native calibration requires nonempty predeclared OOD cohort

implementation_status: draft outside frozen repository; no calibration, model execution or Cargo compilation performed

native_profile.scope: local cold-process sandbox admission, not production latency qualification or daemon activation

normative_reference.resource_limitation: Cold-worker process RSS is a separately declared resident-byte charge, never an allocator allocation upper bound; target-host allocation qualification remains unestablished. Runtime will abstain when the measured charge or full execution latency exceeds the fixed envelope.

observations.action_assignment: actions[cohort_ordinal % 4]; exactly one action after initial encode/plan
observations.id_assignment: ordinal < 32; corruption [clean,occlusion,missing,train][(ordinal // 4) % 4]; preserve public missing-digit hints
observations.ood_assignment: ordinal >= 32; start with clean pair then replace all public pixels and mask by zero, and both digit hints by unknown; retain original keep/swap command
observations.ood_meaning: constructed complete visual-evidence absence without digit hints, outside training observation support; declared from public input transformation, not output error or Target
observations.prior: actual initial encoded/plan state of the same public observation before chosen action
observations.success_label: Reward A caption_valid AND text_fact=relation=image_fact=crossmodal_disagreement=0; original raw caption and quantized PNG scored without repair

preregistration_history.reason: Before any checkpoint load or calibration, source review located the normative thresholds; replace illustrative test-profile thresholds, not outcome-based tuning.

projection.custody: bind full raw request, all model pins, complete previous state and backend_state_sha256; a lossy projection digest alone is insufficient
projection.raw_validation: all 384 IEEE754 float32 values finite and within [-8,8]; no raw clipping

selection.artifact_file_hashes: pin exact selected checkpoint and Reward A bytes once before execution
selection.selection_rule: first registered seed; fixed before formal results; no score-based selection

sources.native_minimum_sample_count_note: NeuronCalibrationProfileV1 and CanonicalPolicyProfileV1 do not specify a minimum; 64 is a bounded pilot design, not an independent-statistics certification
sources.required_disjointness: source IDs and original pixel SHA256 across all named cohorts and excluded ranges
sources.unit: one observation, one chosen action and one label per nonreplacement source pair
